CLM-ARCH-0072.statement: OpenBench-Universe contains 272 benchmarks across 14 application domains.

extra_quotes: In our current implementation, 93% of the open-source projects retrieved in Phase 1 are successfully transformed into standardized benchmarks by this end-to-end flow. All agents are driven by a single backbone model, MiniMax-M2.5, which balances cost efficiency, throughput, and coding proficiency.

We execute this profiling space with the gem5 simulator in Syscall Emulation mode under the x86 ISA. To avoid distortion from unrepresentative setup phases, we fast-forward the first 1B instructions of each benchmark as warmup on a simple CPU with warm caches, then reset all statistics and collect them over a precisely defined 100M-instruction Region of Interest (ROI) executed on the detailed out-of-order core.
A primary limitation is the use of gem5 in syscall-emulation mode, which abstracts away kernel execution, page faults, context switches, and complex input-output behavior.
